cases.long_description: Approximately 7 pm I left my home to walk to the store. I happened to catch something unusual in the sky. It wasn't Mars, Venus, a satellite, star, drone, plane or helo. I have seen these objects before and would recognize them. This object seemed to rotate stationary while projecting several colors. I called my daughter out to see the object for herself to make sure I was seeing what I was seeing. We were both baffled. The object spread apart and then formed as one again while rotating and changing brilliant colors. Hovering still. All colors. Most bizarre. We took 3 videos of this object. About 2 min long a piece. The video from my phone doesn't do justice to actually seeing this object in person. It was crazy and actually scared my daughter. I really don't know what we saw but I thought it would be important to report this incident. Feb 1st 2025. It might be something mundane but I'm not sure. Thank you
cases.location: Observed for 10 min. Hovering over a nuclear power plant. Then object disappeared

cases.long_description: I was taking a picture of the moon and the closest planet from a restaurant parking lot. When I looked at the pictures there was a green object that seemed to be coming in. I took the same picture from my home about 10 minutes later and it was stabilized. In the next picture it seemed to be going away. I also accidentally took a video with my phone and it looks like the green object very faintly was popping around,
cases.location: This green object unseen with naked eye

cases.long_description: I looked up randomly while watching TV outside and saw what looked to be a bright shiny object moving extremely slow. At first I thought it was a balloon, but as I zoomed in on my phone the object started pulsating into a sphere with rings round it. It was moving at random speed and motion. I’ve seen some interesting things in the sky, but this one is the most intriguing because of the sphere like with pulsating lights.
cases.location: Looked like a bright shining object at first, and then shifted into a pulsating sphere for over 8 minutes.

cases.long_description: Had to pull over and video something flying through the night sky that was extremely bright and appeared to have streams of light, or "jet streams" that were extremely bright and left trails for as far as the eye can see... I've just always been curious on what this was...
cases.location: Something flying through the night sky

cases.long_description: I thought it was heavenly being. Saw it two times. Praying. Never spoked.

cases.long_description: There were what I would guess 20 translucent sphere objects that were coming together from opposite directions and then they seemed to perfectly pair and the continue in a pair formation to travel together in perfect synchrony off to the distance. My cell phone captured something and my friend and I stood in awe having no idea what we were looking at. It was an arrangement that I have never seen before. If I were to describe something that appeared to be cloaking itself or have a translucent property to itself that is how I would describe it. There has been a part of me that has wanted to stop by the police department and ask if anyone else reported something but didn't have the confidence I would be taken seriously. I'm not a UFO guy but I have been around drones and this was a massive event in the sky that I don't think could be explained with anything I know that would exist. It was almost like orbs were being directed back to a mother ship off in the far distance

I was outside setting up the telescope. I hadn't put the tube on yet when I saw the object shown in the video. The object was quite high but I could see it pulsating and I knew that it was not a star. I then saw it move. At that point, I pulled out my phone and began filming. Zooming in on the item will reveal an almost acorn shape of pulsating light. The object hovers for about a minute and then slowly moves from the NE to the East. At this point, an aircraft of some sort can be seen flying across the path of the object, nearly missing it. The aircraft is illuminated by the object's glow, and scale can be seen with the aircraft; the object appears to be much larger than the intercepting aircraft. At this point, another object can be seen in the video which I did not see until posting this report and reviewing the video.
cases.location: Three UFOs: Two circular/acorn shaped, and then an orange orb

cases.long_description: Thursday night, at around 8:10 pm, I took my dogs out to potty. Looking to west, past Oklahoma City, there was a light much brighter than everything else in the sky. I pulled out my planet app and it appeared that both Venus and Saturn should have been lower in the sky. Ok, so I thought is that an inbound plane coming straight at me? Nothing on flight tracker apps showed flights going east towards OKC. Called my brother in law a few miles away and he saw it too, also did not align with planets on his app.would love to know if anyone else saw this light Thursday night? It stayed in the sky for at least 50 minutes, staying uniformly bright. It got slightly lower, but I never saw it approach will Rogers airport, which would be south of my vantage point. Came ba k outside around 9:15 and it was gone. Walked around to make sure something had not occluded my view, but I could not see it anywhere. I don’t think a planet would just stop being the brightest thing in the sky, and if it were a plane, how realistic is it that it kept the exact same light brightness as it flew towards me for 50 minutes?
